name: GP Prosperity Plywood Plant - Prosperity SC

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to GP's Prosperity plywood/sawmill operations at 191 Georgia Pacific Blvd, off Hwy 76 E of Prosperity SC (~34.2169,-81.4954, cross-checked against the Forest Products Locator). The roster's geocoded point (34.2093,-81.5332) was ~3 km W in downtown Prosperity and wrong. Site centroid locked at 34.21600,-81.49400.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant access road (Georgia Pacific Blvd) connects to the public road as an open, wide entrance with only a GP sign — no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint at the public-road junction (Street View 2026-02). No gate structure was resolved further in along the entrance road either. Marked false; flagged uncertain because Street View does not cover the interior of the access road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth found at the entrance or along the access road in available imagery. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: A long internal access road runs deep into the property from the public road, with ample room to queue 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open access road and yards with abundant unused paved/graded width.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Log receiving (log yard at the SE plant cluster) and plywood/lumber shipping (NW lumber-storage cluster and rail load-out) are physically separate operations on different parts of the campus.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large building clusters on one property — a SE main plywood plant with log yard and a NW lumber-storage/processing cluster — a campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Plywood/lumber plants load panels and bundles by forklift from open shipping bays rather than truck-height dock doors; banded 0-10, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Yards hold logs and stacked lumber/plywood bundles, not parked trailers.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is operationally expected for a log-receiving mill, but no distinct scale pad could be confirmed in imagery. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail siding runs through the property with railcars present at both the NW and SE clusters.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Numerous structures across two clusters (mill buildings, kilns, storage sheds, office) — counted ~8.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Isolated mill complex surrounded by woods and farmland E of small-town Prosperity. Rural.
